integrity: All formulas are derived analytically and checked at n=3,...,9 by exact rational shortest-path envelope integration; these finite tests are not presented as a proof in all n.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge Cartesian-product ladders with two rails only; no heterogeneous edge lengths or nonuniform sampling.
Only first and second intrinsic pair-distance moments and the stated strong-coupling asymptotic laws; no exact full finite-size distance CDF is asserted.
The first day-resolved archival primary source is the first 2013 version of arXiv:1304.1909. Earlier 1982 papers are cited with year/month precision but their exact first public day is not verified.
Originality remains subject to inaccessible 1982 primary full text and unindexed historical publications.
title: Exact two-moment transport law for open and circular metric ladders
